subject.title: fix(ci): bound Opengrep installer fetch with connect timeout

question: Should the OpenGrep workflow owner approve the proposed 30-second connection and 120-second total-transfer limits for both installer fetches?
rationale: Repository policy treats security-owned workflow files as restricted review surfaces, and selecting the accepted CI failure boundary requires the responsible owner's approval even though the implementation is mechanically sound.

options.title: Approve bounded fetches
options.body: Accept the proposed limits, refresh the branch and checks against current main, then merge if the exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Retune the limits
options.body: Choose different connection or total-transfer thresholds and update both workflows and their shared guard consistently.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded fetches
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed limits, refresh the branch and checks against current main, then merge if the exact-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both OpenGrep workflows and the surrounding security scan design.
